answer: Each agent registers an SGX/TPM enclave key; a zero-knowledge attestation circuit verifies measured code and hardware identity, while oasis is the state tree, ripple the hash-anchor stream, and harbor the consensus contract. Forging N identities requires compromising or physically provisioning N enclaves and producing valid proofs; harbor enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversibly slashes collateral on equivocation.
